reporting_policy: Every user-facing project progress output should report at minimum requirements_structure_percent, g1_system_freeze_percent and backlog_done_percent. Broader engineering percentages must be explicitly labeled estimates.

requirements_structure.meaning: Planned requirement-domain hierarchy/schema/authority coverage, not product-value closure.

g1_system_freeze.note: PB-07 deliberately reopens heavy-lift-dependent values after the product pivot to a 1.5-3.0 kW aggregate-propulsion family. PASS currently retains only the 10-minute mission target, 20% gross-energy reserve, aggregate 1.5-3.0 kW product direction, CAN-FD/Classic-CAN interface and arming/fault authority. The percentage drop is a controlled rebaseline, not loss of historical evidence.

backlog.note: Only the current low-power propulsion market benchmark remains explicitly DONE. The old heavy-lift rotor architecture task was reopened for PB-07 Quad-vs-Hexa selection.

gate_closure.note: G0/G1 are reopened for PB-07 because payload/MTOW, rotor count, battery series count, per-ESC envelope, environment, protection and thermal values must be re-derived.
